svg.title: vue-clamp package benchmark matrix
svg.desc: Full package benchmark matrix with active time by target and adjacent target deltas.
svg.text: Selected versions and snapshots are shown. N/A means no comparable public-matrix payload was supplied.
Green is lower cost, red is higher cost. The first panel shows active ms; the second shows adjacent target deltas.
Some adjacent deltas include correctness fixes that added missing reclamp work; see Markdown comparability notes.
~ and a top-right triangle mark low-confidence deltas; high CV, overlapping mean MOE, or median/mean direction mismatch is the trigger.
Cell text is median active ms; color is delta vs this scenario's first supported version.
